subject: English
question_text: Complete the following passage using suitable connectors:
stimulus: Ruma is a student of class ten. (a) ___ she is meritorious, she never takes pride in her merit. She is helpful to all. (b) ___ any weak student comes to her with any problem, she tries to help him/her. She is respectful to the seniors (c) ___ affectionate to the juniors. She is simple in behavior (d) ___ strict in principle. (e) ___ everyone loves her.
guide_solution: Complete the passage with connectors: (a) Although (b) If (c) and (d) but (e) Therefore
